# Pavan Kumar Chennupati - Full-Stack Developer

## Summary
Pavan Kumar Chennupati is a Full-Stack Developer and Computer Science undergraduate at PVPSIT. He specializes in building accessible, user-friendly, and responsive applications using modern web technologies like React, Next.js, and Node.js. He has professional intern experience at Accenture and a strong portfolio of personal engineering projects.
